game: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
approach: Static recompilation with the PS2 hardware replaced at engine level: native Vulkan renderer, sound, movies, memory card and pad
notes: Aims for a PS2-accurate PC version (haze and post-processing kept). Playable start to finish; no prebuilt downloads yet. Alongside it, a byte-matching decomp of the DARE sound engine, open to AI-assisted contributors via AGENTS.md.
help: Byte-matching DARE sound engine functions (see AGENTS.md)
